title: Boolean embedding of a mod-two inner product
statement: For every natural number $m$ and every pair of vectors $x,y\in(\mathbb F_2)^m$, concatenate them to form $z=(x,y)\in(\mathbb F_2)^{2m}$. The real embedding of the mod-two inner product of the two blocks is $\bigl(1-(-1)^{\langle x,y\rangle}\bigr)/2$, where the inner product is computed in $\mathbb F_2$.
hypotheses_covered: $z$ is a vector of length $m+m$ over $\mathbb F_2$
